title: Sky ship with glowing sails snags a London chimney with its anchor

tellings.quote: I read a story of a a sailing ship with glowing sails flying over London and an anchor comes out and snags a chimney and breaks the top off of a chimney.

plain: In the early 1800s a sailing ship with glowing sails is said to have flown over London, dropped an anchor, snagged a chimney and broken its top off. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him, tells this as a story he once read, without naming where. If true, it would be a very old report of a craft in the sky that touched something on the ground.
